website.error: Site only serves a JS redirect to /lander; no public pipeline page

commercial_product.note: Pre-revenue. Subsidiaries mRNA for Life, Inc. and Precision Genomics, Inc. are developing mRNA-based genetic biomarker assays from cheek-swab samples for inflammation-driven diseases (heart disease, diabetes, preeclampsia, autism spectrum disorder, etc.). No FDA-cleared product or registered clinical trial as of the 2025 10-K.

excluded_preclinical.asset: mRNA Neuro Panel and Serotonin Assay (Tryptamine Derivatives and mRNA Measurements)
excluded_preclinical.stage: Patent application U.S. 18/705375 (April 2024); IP licensed from Nova Mentis Life Science Corp.; no clinical trial registered

excluded_preclinical.asset: ASD mRNA cheek-swab biomarker (Ambert/Molinaro evaluation, 30-40 patients)
excluded_preclinical.stage: Exploratory analytical evaluation, not an IND/clinical trial

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Early-stage mRNA biomarker / molecular-diagnostics development company; all programs are preclinical/IP-stage with no IND filed, no FDA clearance, and no registered ctgov P1/P2/P3 trials. Bucketed as services/CRO/lab; effectively a pre-revenue diagnostic R&D shell.
